Subject: Your land dispute matter - O.S. No. 1118/2023

Dear Mr. Khan,

Thank you for meeting us on 5 April 2023 about your dispute with Ajay Mukherjee. As we understand it, relatives dispute who owns the ancestral land. The matter is listed before the Bengaluru District Court.

Our advice is to trace the chain of title through the mutation entries. Please collect the mutation entries, the partition deed and the old sale deeds and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of INR 4,19,00,000/-.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
